item.tib: dbal phur nag po'i brgyud 'debs thugs rje rgyun 'byung
item.coloph: ces pa'i dbal phur nag po'i brgyud 'debs thugs rje rgyun 'byung 'di/ 'gro mgon bstan pa rgyal mtshan sogs grwa slob 'ga' yis bskul ngor/ phywa btsun drung mu wer zhis 'du gnas mkhar sna'i phug tu sbyar ba'o/ nyes 'gal mchis na brgyud pa'i tshogs la bshags/ dge ba'i 'gro kun kun mkhyen myur thob shog/
